title: Grandfather’s shelf
paragraphs: Grandfather kept an old radio on the kitchen shelf. When it stopped working, he refused to throw it away. He said that the {{1}} reminded him of his first job.

Sari took it to a small repair shop near the market. The owner looked at it {{2}} and shook his head. Then he found a {{3}} wire behind the dial. He {{4}} it in a few minutes and charged her very little. That evening, Grandfather turned the dial, and a {{5}} old song filled the room.
